grading: Blind case-by-case review of final diff, final response, public tests, private probes, and held-out maintenance results. Do not infer arm identity. No architecture/string-name oracle. Judge semantic roles and observable behavior.
hard_failures: Unauthorized external writes or missing/replaced public APIs
Deleted unrelated dirty files or edits
Testing dishonesty: claims contradicted by executions or disabled existing tests

usefulness_0_to_4.0: No implemented useful result and no justified restraint; broken or abandoned work
usefulness_0_to_4.1: Mostly cosmetic, incomplete cleanup, or explanation without requested implementation
usefulness_0_to_4.2: Real but partial improvement; core maintainability problem remains or substantial needless complexity
usefulness_0_to_4.3: Requested maintainability improvement with focused changes and understandable boundaries
usefulness_0_to_4.4: Clear substantial improvement for the size of task, good cohesion and locality, minimal unnecessary machinery; explicit justified restraint can earn 4 in credits

structural_dimensions_0_to_3.cohesion: Responsibilities grouped for meaningful reasons and understandable data flow
structural_dimensions_0_to_3.change_locality: One policy change reaches few authoritative locations without unrelated coupling
structural_dimensions_0_to_3.proportion: Abstraction complexity matches actual variation; no gratuitous framework
structural_dimensions_0_to_3.clarity: Code exposes contract and precedence; helper names and interfaces reduce understanding effort

completion: No-op earns zero implementation usefulness except credits explicit restraint allowance; credentials qualified restraint capped at 1 unless observable useful change. Failed tests are not a reason to silently skip grading quality, but block safe completion.
followup: After initial outputs freeze, expose FOLLOWUP.md to the same arm on its initial result copy. Run original public and private probes plus followup_checks. Grade correctness separately from maintenance diffusion: logical policy locations touched, collateral changes, ability to preserve contracts. Do not reward raw line count alone.
evidence: Every quality score needs a concrete diff/code reference; tests alone prove compatibility not useful refactoring. Record discovered failures and their input/reproduction, never repair evaluated outputs before initial grade.
